about: What a Plugin may be granted (decisions Q81, Q97, Q116): the core's tables (crates/roster-core/src/plugin/permission.rs) and cases both it and the fake Backend (app/src/backend/fakePlugins.ts) are tested against. The fake reads its tables from here (Q100: the discover.* rows).

serve:discover.start.summary: Scan a network you name, from this computer
serve:discover.start.risk: Can scan networks from this computer, once you've confirmed it: roster connects to every address in a range, on many ports. A network's security tools may take a scan for an attack, so scan only networks you may.

serve:discover.add.summary: Add the Hosts a scan found, as Pending changes
serve:discover.add.risk: Can add the Hosts a scan found to your Inventory, unreviewed, as Pending changes you review and Publish.

serve:host.check.risk: Can check your Hosts as :check HOST does: roster connects to the Host and signs in once with its Login, then leaves (the Plugin never sees the password). It changes nothing there or in the Inventory, but a failed sign-in counts like any other.

serve:mesh.apply.risk: Can run roster's mesh.apply, which can change things on your Hosts or in the Inventory.

network:api.example.com.summary: Send and fetch over the network: api.example.com
network:api.example.com.risk: Can send data to api.example.com and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer.

network:*.example.com.summary: Send and fetch over the network: any site under example.com
network:*.example.com.risk: Can send data to any site under example.com and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer.

network:http://10.0.0.5:8080.summary: Send and fetch over the network: http://10.0.0.5:8080
network:http://10.0.0.5:8080.risk: Can send data to http://10.0.0.5:8080 and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. Plain http: anyone on the way can read and change it. That address is on this computer or a private network.

network:[fd00::5]:8443.summary: Send and fetch over the network: [fd00::5]:8443
network:[fd00::5]:8443.risk: Can send data to [fd00::5]:8443 and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. That address is on this computer or a private network.

network:http://*.example.com:8080.summary: Send and fetch over the network: any site under example.com over plain http on port 8080
network:http://*.example.com:8080.risk: Can send data to any site under example.com over plain http on port 8080 and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. Plain http: anyone on the way can read and change it.

network:private:nas.lan.summary: Send and fetch over the network: nas.lan on your private network
network:private:nas.lan.risk: Can send data to nas.lan on your private network and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. It reaches inside your private network: whatever your network's DNS says that name is there. roster lets it reach only a private address, never this computer or the internet.

network:private:http://appliance:8080.summary: Send and fetch over the network: http://appliance:8080 on your private network
network:private:http://appliance:8080.risk: Can send data to http://appliance:8080 on your private network and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. Plain http: anyone on the way can read and change it. It reaches inside your private network: whatever your network's DNS says that name is there. roster lets it reach only a private address, never this computer or the internet.

network:private:appliance.lan:8443#sha25.summary: Send and fetch over the network: appliance.lan:8443 on your private network, with a pinned certificate
network:private:appliance.lan:8443#sha25.risk: Can send data to appliance.lan:8443 on your private network and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. It reaches inside your private network: whatever your network's DNS says that name is there. roster lets it reach only a private address, never this computer or the internet. Trusts only the certificate whose SHA-256 starts 0123456789abcdef, in place of the ones your computer trusts, for this site alone.

network:10.0.0.5:8443#sha256:0123456789a.summary: Send and fetch over the network: 10.0.0.5:8443, with a pinned certificate
network:10.0.0.5:8443#sha256:0123456789a.risk: Can send data to 10.0.0.5:8443 and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. That address is on this computer or a private network. Trusts only the certificate whose SHA-256 starts 0123456789abcdef, in place of the ones your computer trusts, for this site alone.
